d:
Ganesh Chaturthi is all about welcoming Bappa with love, devotion and delicious festive bhog!
This festive season, make Bappa’s bhog extra special with 4 delicious recipes — traditional Ukdiche Modak, aromatic Patoli, flavourful Sandesh Modak and easy Coconut Modak.
From the classic combination of coconut and jaggery to exciting twists with rose petals, pistachios, crunchy nuts and condensed milk, these festive sweets are perfect for celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi at home.
So get your kitchen ready, make these special treats with love and offer them to Bappa!
